description: This file declares the GDBus manager class for NetworkManager, providing methods to obtain proxies to various NetworkManager services and configurations via GDBus. It manages GDBus connection and proxy objects within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.
external_methods: GDBusProxy* g_dbus_proxy_new_for_bus(GDBusBusType bus_type, GDBusProxyFlags flags, GDBusInterfaceInfo *info, const gchar * bus_name, const gchar * object_path, const gchar * interface_name, GCancellable * cancellable, GError ** error)

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A class that manages GDBus proxies to interact with NetworkManager services, providing various getter methods for different NetworkManager proxies and connection.
